items.title: Official Press Statement on Community Engagement
items.summary: Babatunde Sunday Ogunlade reaffirmed his commitment to inclusive development and direct engagement with residents across Ibarapa East.
items.body: Babatunde Sunday Ogunlade, candidate of the All Progressives Congress (APC), held a structured engagement with community leaders, traders, youth groups, and residents to discuss development priorities, infrastructure needs, and inclusive governance. The session focused on practical, people-centered solutions to strengthen access to education, healthcare, security, and local economic growth. The campaign team reiterated its commitment to transparent communication and responsive leadership in the constituency.
